nodes.label: DTS E-Commerce
nodes.description: Full-stack delivery platform monorepo with 6-phase incremental development

nodes.label: Monorepo with 4 Submodules
nodes.description: Git submodule architecture with backend, web-admin, flutter-customer, and flutter-driver as independent repositories

nodes.label: Backend (Django + DRF)
nodes.description: Django REST API with PostGIS, Celery, Channels, and Redis at github.com/osedhelu/DTS-backend

nodes.label: Web Admin (Next.js + React)
nodes.description: Next.js 16 merchant and super admin portal with Tailwind CSS v4 and Zustand at github.com/osedhelu/DTS-web-admin

nodes.label: Flutter Customer App
nodes.description: Flutter customer mobile app with Riverpod state management at github.com/osedhelu/DTS-flutter-customer

nodes.label: Flutter Driver App
nodes.description: Flutter driver mobile app with Riverpod state management at github.com/osedhelu/DTS-flutter-driver

nodes.label: Fase 1 - Backend Architecture
nodes.description: Foundational backend: Django setup, accounts, stores, products, orders, delivery, and API (100% complete)

nodes.label: Bloque 1.1 - Django Setup
nodes.description: Initialize Django 5.x with DRF, PostGIS, Redis, uv package manager, pytest, and feature structure

nodes.label: Bloque 1.2 - Accounts
nodes.description: CustomUser with roles (SUPER_ADMIN, MERCHANT, DRIVER, CUSTOMER), profiles, JWT auth, FCM device tokens

nodes.label: User Roles
nodes.description: Enum with values: SUPER_ADMIN, MERCHANT, DRIVER, CUSTOMER

nodes.label: Device Token FCM
nodes.description: DeviceToken model for push notification registration prerequisite to Fase 2

nodes.label: Bloque 1.3 - Stores
nodes.description: Store entity with GeoLocation (PostGIS PointField), Open/Closed status, CRUD operations

nodes.label: PostGIS Database
nodes.description: Geospatial database extension storing store and delivery locations as PointField

nodes.label: Bloque 1.4 - Products
nodes.description: Dual catalog: ProductType.PHYSICAL (food, retail) and ProductType.SERVICE with categories, subcategories, stock validation

nodes.label: ProductType Enum
nodes.description: PHYSICAL (comida, retail) vs SERVICE (domiciliary services like cleaning, repairs)

nodes.label: StoreVertical Enum
nodes.description: FOOD, SERVICES, RETAIL — determines template categories and product configuration

nodes.label: Bloque 1.5 - Orders
nodes.description: Order and OrderItem models with OrderStateMachine (delivery) and ServiceOrderStateMachine (services without drivers)

nodes.label: OrderStatus Enum
nodes.description: Delivery: CREATED→ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT→IN_PREPARATION→READY_FOR_PICKUP→SEARCHING_DRIVER→DRIVER_ASSIGNED→PICKED_UP→ON_THE_WAY→DELIVERED (plus CANCELLED)

nodes.label: ServiceOrderStatus Enum
nodes.description: Service orders without driver: CREATED→ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT→SCHEDULED→PROVIDER_EN_ROUTE→IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED (plus CANCELLED)

nodes.label: Bloque 1.6 - Delivery
nodes.description: DeliveryTracking with TrackingPoint history for GPS location recording and customer tracking

nodes.label: Bloque 1.7 - API Global
nodes.description: Centralized router with /api/v1 versioning, drf-spectacular OpenAPI, pagination, throttling

nodes.label: Fase 2 - Async Logic & Events
nodes.description: Celery workers, Redis broker, signals, driver assignment, push notifications, analytics (100% complete)

nodes.label: Celery + Redis Broker
nodes.description: Redis-backed task queue for async operations: driver assignment, push notifications, email

nodes.label: Django Signals Pattern
nodes.description: post_save signals on Order status change trigger Celery tasks for notifications and driver assignment

nodes.label: DriverMatcher Service
nodes.description: Domain service finding nearest online driver by location for order assignment

nodes.label: FCM Push Notifications
nodes.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging for order status updates, driver offers, customer/driver alerts

nodes.label: NotificationType Enum
nodes.description: Push templates mapped to OrderStatus changes (order_accepted, on_the_way, ready_for_pickup, etc.)

nodes.label: DailySalesReport
nodes.description: Nightly aggregation (02:00 Celery Beat) of sales, commissions, and driver earnings

nodes.label: Fase 3 - Web Admin Frontend
nodes.description: Next.js merchant portal and super admin dashboard with Tailwind + Zustand (100% complete)

nodes.label: Merchant Portal
nodes.description: Web interface for merchants to manage products, inventory, orders, and metrics

nodes.label: Super Admin Dashboard
nodes.description: Global metrics, commissions, KPIs, coupon management

nodes.label: Zustand Store Pattern
nodes.description: Lightweight state management per feature (merchant-session-store, products-store, orders-store, ui-store)

nodes.label: Fase 6 - Merchant Onboarding Portal
nodes.description: Public registration wizard, email verification, enriched catalog (variants, ingredients, photos), dashboard, promotions, store config (100% complete)

nodes.label: EmailVerificationToken
nodes.description: UUID token with 24-hour expiry for merchant email verification

nodes.label: RegisterMerchantWithStoreUseCase
nodes.description: Atomic operation creating User + MerchantProfile + Store + seed categories by vertical

nodes.label: ProductVariant
nodes.description: Size/portion options (S/M/L/XL) with individual pricing for PHYSICAL products in FOOD/RETAIL

nodes.label: ProductIngredient
nodes.description: Ingredient list with optional allergen flag for food products

nodes.label: ProductImage
nodes.description: File field with is_primary flag for product gallery

nodes.label: StorePromotion
nodes.description: Per-store discount (percentage or fixed) with validity range, applies to product or entire store

nodes.label: Media Serving (SERVE_MEDIA)
nodes.description: Backend serving /media/ with MEDIA_PUBLIC_BASE_URL for product photos and store logos

nodes.label: Fase 4 - Flutter Mobile
nodes.description: Customer app (stores, catalog, cart, checkout, tracking) and driver app (availability, orders, location) (100% complete)

nodes.label: Flutter Customer App
nodes.description: Blocks 4.1-4.5: login, stores list, catalog with filters, cart, checkout, order tracking with push

nodes.label: Flutter Driver App
nodes.description: Blocks 4.6-4.9: login, online/offline toggle, offer acceptance, GPS background location tracking

nodes.label: Fase 5 - Real-time Tracking
nodes.description: Django Channels WebSocket for live driver location with <2s latency (70% complete)

nodes.label: Django Channels
nodes.description: WebSocket server with Redis channel layer for real-time location broadcast
